fieldset.name: ai_tools
fieldset.label: AI Writing and Images
fieldset.description: AI drafts are reviewed before applying. Requests send the selected content to your provider and may incur API charges. Server environment variables OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY take precedence over saved keys.

field.name: ai_openai_key
field.label: OpenAI API key
field.description: Stored encrypted. Leave blank to keep the saved key.

field.name: ai_claude_key
field.label: Claude API key
field.description: Stored encrypted. Leave blank to keep the saved key.

field.name: ai_openai_model_custom
field.label: Custom OpenAI text model ID
field.description: Enter the exact model ID. It must support the selected provider API and this task.

field.name: ai_claude_model_custom
field.label: Custom Claude text model ID
field.description: Enter the exact model ID. It must support the selected provider API and this task.

field.name: ai_image_model_custom
field.label: Custom OpenAI image model ID
field.description: Enter the exact model ID. It must support the selected provider API and this task.

field.name: ai_hourly_limit
field.label: Requests per user session per hour

field.name: ai_permissions_note
field.label: Permissions
field.description: Grant the Use AI tools permission in component permissions. Users also need post editing permission; image generation requires Joomla Media create permission.

field.name: featured_slider_content_length
field.label: Maximum Content (Characters)
field.description: 0 displays the complete text. Empty inherits the component setting.

field.name: comments_cooldown
field.label: Seconds between comments from one visitor

field.name: subscribe_text
field.label: COM_BLOG_SUBSCRIBE_TEXT
field.default: Subscribe for updates and new posts.

field.name: subscribe_consent
field.label: COM_BLOG_SUBSCRIBE_CONSENT
field.default: I agree to receive email updates and can unsubscribe at any time.

fieldset.name: automated_truncation
fieldset.label: Automated Truncation
fieldset.description: Shorten list content automatically. Manual excerpts and Read More splits take precedence. Featured slider content uses its own settings.

field.name: truncation_audio_position
field.label: Position of Audio Embed After Truncation

field.name: list_excerpt_length
field.label: Maximum Content (Characters or Words)
field.description: 0 displays all content without automatic truncation.

field.name: truncation_paragraphs
field.label: Maximum Paragraph (Paragraph or Break Tags)
field.description: 0 displays all content without automatic truncation.

field.name: listing_authors
field.label: Filter by Authors
field.description: Leave empty for no restriction. Exclusions take priority over included items.

field.name: listing_exclude_authors
field.label: Exclude Authors
field.description: Leave empty for no restriction. Exclusions take priority over included items.

field.name: listing_categories
field.label: Filter by Categories
field.description: Leave empty for no restriction. Exclusions take priority over included items.

field.name: listing_exclude_categories
field.label: Exclude Categories
field.description: Leave empty for no restriction. Exclusions take priority over included items.

field.name: listing_tags
field.label: Filter by Tags
field.description: Leave empty for no restriction. Exclusions take priority over included items.

field.name: listing_canonical
field.label: Custom Canonical Link
field.description: Optional absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL for this listing page.
